completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10849_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of a National Trade School. -The name of Alcantara National Trade School in the Municipality of Alcantara, Province of Romblon is hereby changed to Romblon National Institute of Technology.
Location of the Main Campus. – The main campus of the Romblon National Institute of Technology shall continue to remain in its present location in the Municipality of Alcantara, Province of Romblon.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
